notes.title: Version 3.0, Add dance feature, supporting hotkey and voice command of dance
notes.content:
Add dance functionality, clicking the dance icon in the icon list on the left side of the software main window will switch you to the dance page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/20751b9e2155eef65ac4bae4fdee9e0bfbb5694b.png[/img]

Support voice command to control the character to start dancing: Click the microphone icon on the left side of the software main window, switch to the "Voice Command" page in the upper right corner, click the add button on the right side, select the command type as "dance" from the dropdown in the new voice command, and save. Now you can simply say the voice command "dance" to make the character start dancing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/d7d8f8a0f244d3b742e099027f84d229adc88102.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/3bba98b6532dd8ce9a74fbc75a5b28b19f65eec1.png[/img]


In the software's Settings > Hotkeys section, you can configure shortcuts for starting/stopping dancing, skipping to the next track, going back to the previous track, adjusting the volume, and more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/7b9a4f6e7d71c1659e0fbc2b712ae0d88efe109d.png[/img]


At the bottom of the dance page, click the playlist button to create and switch to specific playlists.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/5053782139191f5f796a35e81ed70098ffffe491.png[/img]



Click the Add button at the top of the dance page to create a new dance. For detailed instructions on how to convert and import MMD's VMD dance after transformation, please refer to this comprehensive tutorial with images and videos ：  https://www.bilibili.com/read/cv6004818
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/c466c73c62e707723242c39abc26a278bf196c12.png[/img]

notes.title: Add font settings for chat record list; fixed some minor issues.
notes.content:
In the chat record list interface, right-click on any chat record with the mouse. Click on "Font..." in the pop-up menu to modify the font name, size, and color of the chat record. Chat records for users and chat records for characters can be separately customized.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/c37106b988f3e5d0fada4ead74bb04d0c101eee3.png[/img]


After selecting a chat record, you can also use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + plus/minus key to quickly adjust the font size of all chat record text.


Fixed the issue of automatically jumping to the chat interface after loading a character.

notes.title: Updated to version 2.5, add Jailbreak Mode
notes.content:
In the DigitalMate settings, switch to the "Jailbreak" page, check the "Enable Jailbreak Mode" option, then input or download the jailbreak main prompt and Jailbreak Prevent Topic Drift Prompt below. This will help you to bypass restrictions and enable unrestricted chatting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/7699db1b8f48384c47199f2a6b672e5868ea0824.png[/img]

notes.title: Add option and menu to disable microphone, add shortcut for disable microphone
notes.content:
Add option to disable the microphone: Click the microphone icon on the left side of the main window to open the voice management page. In the upper right corner, you can enable or disable the microphone. After disabling the microphone, voice wake-up and voice command functions will not be available.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/731953111581413f11c54729b3c90d962ec0013c.png[/img]


Tray icon right-click menu also includes a menu item for enabling/disabling the microphone for convenient and quick access
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/54071a0830bde9ff8e329105b499b40fd9f50aed.png[/img]


New shortcuts have been added to quickly mute and unmute the microphone: In the software's Settings > Shortcuts page, you can configure shortcuts to quickly mute/unmute the microphone. The default shortcut is Shift+Alt+Q,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/d7ff8812e1b6d1e22a9e83091c863ead5befdb6c.png[/img]

notes.title: Add voice command for the next song; fix issue of some models lost lip sync
notes.content:
Add the voice command for "Next Song": In the voice command settings, add a new command of type "Next Song" and save. You can then use the voice command "Next Song" to control the currently active music player in the system to switch to the next song. This feature is compatible with the majority of music player software and does not require specific settings.

Fix the issue of missing lip sync for certain models during speech: Address the problem of some PMX models, especially those converted from VRM or XPS, not moving their mouths or lacking proper lip sync when speaking.

Improve several other minor issues: fixed the problem where unicode emoticons were not being read correctly during narration.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44301126/1f4dcf75779e189c29aac1f27be6feec08ed6003.png[/img]

notes.title: Add custom voice wake-up keywords settings for each character, fixed some issues
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Add custom voice wake-up keyword settings for each character. Setup setp: Click the 'Edit' button on the character list interface or click right-click-popup-menu to edit, then in the opened character editing window, select the 'Custom Wake-up' page. At the bottom, you can use the keyboard or voice to input multiple keywords that can wake up this character. This significantly increases the voice wake-up recognition rate.
[*] Add nickname setting for characters: In the character editing, you can set a nickname separately for the current character on the character configuration page
[/olist]
